boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Named Duluth-campus spaces for studying, gathering, recreation, and reflection, documented by St. Scholastica’s current campus-life and facilities pages.

cards.title: St. Scholastica Student Center
cards.subtitle: Duluth main campus
cards.notes: Meet classmates in one of the common areas or on the patio, then use the building’s study rooms or booths to keep a group project moving.
cards.short_summary: A campus hub built around places to study, eat, meet, and socialize.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Center has 10 common areas, an outdoor patio, eight study rooms, 12 study booths, Student Activities, Campus Ministry, and Seekers Café.
cards.access_notes: The College describes it as a Duluth-main-campus student space; check event and building access details before visiting.

cards.entity_name: The College of St. Scholastica Library
cards.title: The College of St. Scholastica Library
cards.subtitle: Duluth main campus
cards.notes: Choose the designated quiet or group-study area that matches your task, and ask library staff for help locating research materials when needed.
cards.short_summary: Three floors support both focused solo work and collaborative study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library has three floors with designated areas for quiet and group study, and it provides research support and public computers.
cards.source_title: Library Resources | The College of St. Scholastica
cards.access_notes: The Library welcomes visitors and local users; identification is required for some services.

cards.title: Burns Wellness Commons
cards.subtitle: Duluth main campus
cards.notes: Use the track, courts, fitness areas, or climbing facilities through Campus Recreation, and check the current posted schedule before planning a workout.
cards.short_summary: A 63,000-square-foot recreation complex with indoor movement and fitness spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Burns Wellness Commons includes running tracks, multi-purpose courts, batting cages, a weight room, fitness/dance studio, cardio mezzanine, climbing wall, and Reif Gymnasium.
cards.access_notes: Campus Recreation facilities and memberships are available to current students, faculty, and staff; regular hours are listed as Monday–Friday, 7 a.m.–7 p.m.

cards.title: Reif Gymnasium
cards.subtitle: Inside Burns Wellness Commons, Duluth main campus
cards.notes: Check the athletics or recreation schedule for a game, then use the main floor and side courts only when the space is available for your activity.
cards.short_summary: The gym is the campus venue for basketball and volleyball courts.
cards.evidence_claim: Reif Gymnasium contains the main-floor basketball and volleyball courts plus two side basketball or volleyball courts.
cards.access_notes: Located within Campus Recreation facilities, whose access is limited to eligible College community members and membership holders.

cards.title: Burns Wellness Commons Climbing Wall
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Pursuit, Duluth main campus
cards.notes: Start with the training and coaching offered by Outdoor Pursuit, then choose a route suited to your experience level and follow staff guidance.
cards.short_summary: A 40-foot indoor wall with bouldering and lead-climbing options.
cards.evidence_claim: Outdoor Pursuit manages the 40-foot indoor climbing wall; it has bouldering space, five lead lines, adaptive equipment, and routes for all abilities.
cards.source_title: Outdoor Recreation at St. Scholastica: Explore Campus Life
cards.access_notes: The wall operates fall through spring and is closed during academic breaks; St. Scholastica students climb free, while guests need daily passes.

cards.title: Saints Field
cards.subtitle: Near the Monastery, Duluth main campus
cards.notes: Look for an open intramural league, tournament, or fitness class, and use the field only through scheduled recreation or team activity.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus field shared by Saints teams and intramural programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Saints Field, near the Monastery, is used by Saints teams for practice and for outdoor intramural leagues, tournaments, and fitness classes.
cards.access_notes: Use is tied to team practices and Campus Recreation programming; confirm scheduling and participation details with Campus Recreation.

cards.entity_name: Our Lady Queen of Peace Chapel
cards.title: Our Lady Queen of Peace Chapel
cards.subtitle: Duluth main campus
cards.notes: Step in for quiet personal reflection, observing the chapel’s contemplative purpose and the needs of anyone using the space for prayer.
cards.short_summary: A stained-glass campus chapel welcoming people of all backgrounds.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Ministry identifies Our Lady Queen of Peace Chapel as a space for personal prayer with stained glass and icons, and says all are welcome.
cards.source_title: Campus Ministry at St. Scholastica: Engage, Grow, Serve
cards.access_notes: Campus Ministry describes the chapel as welcoming to all; respect services, prayer, and any posted access guidance.

cards.title: The Oratory
cards.subtitle: Student Center 115, Duluth main campus
cards.notes: Use this small prayer room alone or with a small group when you need a brief, intentional reset between classes or meetings.
cards.short_summary: A Student Center prayer room for reflection and small groups.
cards.evidence_claim: The Oratory is in Student Center 115 and is available to individuals or small groups; Campus Ministry says all are welcome.
cards.source_title: Campus Ministry at St. Scholastica: Engage, Grow, Serve
cards.access_notes: Campus Ministry describes the Oratory as available to individuals and small groups; preserve its reflective use.

cards.title: Valley of Silence
cards.subtitle: Wooded Duluth campus trails
cards.notes: Take a nature walk on the campus trails and pause at a safe, marked viewpoint; dress for the weather and stay on established routes.
cards.short_summary: A named wooded campus area connected to reflective nature walks.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Ministry invites community members to walk the trails through the Valley of Silence as part of nature walks on the Duluth campus.
cards.source_title: Campus Ministry at St. Scholastica: Engage, Grow, Serve
cards.access_notes: The College describes the area in connection with campus nature walks; use established trails and follow seasonal conditions and posted guidance.

cards.title: Gethsemane Cemetery
cards.subtitle: Duluth main campus nature-walk area
cards.notes: Visit quietly as part of a campus nature walk, keeping clear of memorial areas and following any posted restrictions or College guidance.
cards.short_summary: A named cemetery included in the College’s campus reflection routes.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Ministry names Gethsemane Cemetery as a place where community members may pause during nature walks on the Duluth campus.
cards.source_title: Campus Ministry at St. Scholastica: Engage, Grow, Serve
cards.access_notes: This is a cemetery and reflection area; visit respectfully and follow posted access guidance.
